# Calculator — Free Calculators & Unit Converters

> Free online calculators and unit converters for Tanzania and worldwide — USD↔TZS, PAYE tax, loans, percentages, BMI and metric/imperial conversions. Rates and tax bands are indicative and should be verified.

- [USD to TZS](https://www.calculator.co.tz/usd-to-tzs): Live US Dollar to Tanzanian Shilling converter.
- [TZS to USD](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tzs-to-usd): Tanzanian Shilling to US Dollar converter.
- [Tanzania PAYE Tax Brackets](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tanzania/paye-tax-brackets): Current TRA resident monthly bands.
- [Tanzania PAYE Calculator](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tools/tanzania-paye-calculator): Take-home pay after PAYE income tax.
- [Tanzania Currency Guide](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tanzania/currency): How the TZS and the USD↔TZS rate work.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tools/currency-converter): 100+ currencies with live rates.
- [Loan Calculator](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tools/loan-calculator)
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tools/mortgage-calculator)
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tools/compound-interest-calculator)
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tools/percentage-calculator)
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.calculator.co.tz/tools/bmi-calculator)
